subject: Coord: Varuna Tech co-sell demo — slot arbitration for APAC-friendly window
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@varunatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Varuna co-sell demo — need an APAC-friendly slot (agenda attached)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the intro call last week. Varuna + Redwood co-sell demo next week would be great to land with your Solutions team and our field SEs.

Can we lock a 60-minute slot that works for APAC stakeholders (SG/HK/IN) while still being reasonable for Redwood West Coast folks? Proposed windows below — please pick 1 or suggest alternatives: 

- Tue Jul 6, 09:00–10:00 SGT (Tue Jul 6, 18:00–19:00 PDT)
- Wed Jul 7, 14:00–15:00 SGT (Wed Jul 7, 23:00–00:00 PDT) — awkward for Redwood but possible if needed
- Thu Jul 8, 07:30–08:30 SGT (Wed Jul 7, 16:30–17:30 PDT)

Attached a brief agenda and run-of-show. CC'ing Karthik and Ben to iron out the technical runbook and access requirements. Monica from CS will join for handoff if you want her on the call.

Thanks — Vanessa

Attachments: Varuna-Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@varunatech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@varunatech.com>, solutions@varunatech.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 22:08:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Varuna co-sell demo — need an APAC-friendly slot (agenda attached)

Hi Vanessa — thanks, appreciate the concrete windows. Priya and I checked with Solutions and the preferred is Thu Jul 8 07:30–08:30 SGT. That slot hits our pre-sales team's morning and includes a SME who owns the network diagram.

Two notes: 
1) Our security reviewer asked whether Redwood requires inbound connections to Varuna test VPCs; we can discuss but please have the SEs list any IPs/ports needed.
2) Can we shorten to 45 minutes if we keep the agenda tight? Back-to-back calendar pressure on our side.

I'll attach a diagram our network SME wants to show. If 45 minutes is OK, Priya suggests we do a compact run: 10m intros, 25m demo, 10m next steps.

—Samir

Attachments: varuna-network-topology.png (PNG, 1 file)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 01:30:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Varuna co-sell demo — internal alignment before confirming

Vanessa / Ben — quick sync: Samir prefers Thu Jul 8 at 07:30 SGT and wants to shrink to 45m. Operational asks:

- I can do 10m intros + 25m demo + 10m next steps in 45m, but Ben will need the shortened runbook (highlighted flows). Ben — can you trim the demo to 20–25m focusing on the scale/perf story and the model routing use-case?
- Network: Monica, can you confirm whether we need to open any inbound ports or if everything will be behind proxies? If inbound IPs are required we need that list by Mon Jul 5.
- Scheduling: APAC-friendly — Vanessa, do you want me to reply to Samir confirming 07:30 SGT and propose the 45m agenda? I can include the calendar invite link and note about pre-call network checklist.

If everyone ok, I'll confirm with Varuna later today (their morning).

Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 02:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Varuna co-sell demo — internal alignment before confirming

Sounds good — I'll compress the demo script: cut the full throughput bench and focus on a single end-to-end latency + failover scenario that illustrates smart routing. Will produce a 2-slide summary to drop into the 25m demo slot.

Monica — please confirm networking checklist: specifically whether Redwood needs any inbound rules for our demo agents or whether Varuna will host the demo endpoints. If Varuna hosts, we only need a short list of DNS names and the authentication fallback. If we need to initiate connections outbound from our demo environment to theirs, note of expected ports would be helpful.

I'll have the trimmed runbook ready by Mon 10:00 PDT.
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@varunatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 03:05:00 +10:00
Subject: Re: Varuna co-sell demo — need an APAC-friendly slot (agenda attached)

Thanks all — Thu Jul 8, 07:30–08:15 SGT (45m) works for us.

Network note: Varuna will host the demo endpoints in our staging VPC. No inbound rules needed from Redwood into our VPC; Redwood can make outbound HTTPS calls to the demo endpoints. Attached is the network topology (same file). Also adding a short pre-demo checklist:

- Redwood to confirm origin IP ranges for any automated health checks (optional)
- Test credentials will be shared via secure link 24h before the demo
- Conference bridge: Google Meet link provided on the calendar invite

Confirming we received Vanessa's agenda; Ben, the 2-slide perf/failover highlight sounds perfect. See you on Jul 8. I'll send the Meet link and test creds on Jul 7.

Best, Samir

Related link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz123-varuna-demo
Attachments: varuna-network-topology.png
